verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy won the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Rory McIlroy ran it back at Augusta National... to claim his second consecutive green jacket." (R1); "Rory McIlroy became the first back-to-back Masters champion... Sunday, April 12." (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm McIlroy's win on the specified date at the 2026 Masters.

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy became the fourth player in history to win back-to-back green jackets.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "making him just the fourth golfer in history to win the event in back-to-back years." (R1); "McIlroy is just the fourth golfer to win back-to-back Masters tournaments, joining Jack Nicklaus (1965-66), Nick Faldo (1989-90) and Tiger Woods (2001-02)." (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state he is the fourth to win back-to-back Masters.

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy finished 12-under par in the 2026 Masters.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "win at 13-under" and "1. Rory McIlroy (-13)" (R1); "1. Rory McIlroy -12 (F)" but payout "(-13)" (R2); "finish at 12 under par" (R4); "1. Rory McIlroy: -12 (F)" (R5); "total of 12-under" (R6); "score of 12-under par" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict: R1 consistently reports -13, while R4-R7 report -12 (R2 mixed).
